records.source: The bus to Calico Desert is out of service.
records.translation: Hindi bumibiyahe ang bus patungong Disyerto ng Calico.

records.source: Please return when a bus driver is present.
records.translation: Bumalik kapag naroon na ang drayber ng bus.
Nagtataka si {0} kung saan ka nagpunta.

records.source: Your loyal horse waits patiently for your return.
records.translation: Matiyagang naghihintay sa pagbabalik mo ang iyong tapat na kabayo.

records.source: We are the Junimos... Keepers of the forest.
records.translation: Kami ang mga Junimo... Mga tagapag-ingat ng gubat.

records.source: This house was empty for years... The trees moved in and so did we.
records.translation: Walang nakatira sa bahay na ito sa loob ng maraming taon... Lumipat dito ang mga puno, at sumunod kami.

records.source: We're happy to help... It's not our house, after all.
records.translation: Masaya kaming tumulong... Hindi naman namin bahay ito.

records.source: So many wonderful bundles... thank you! Thank you!
When we're done here, we'll return to the other world.
records.translation: Kapag tapos na kami rito, babalik kami sa kabilang daigdig.

records.source: The Junimos have returned to the spirit world.
records.translation: Bumalik na ang mga Junimo sa daigdig ng mga espiritu.

records.source: A slime escaped during the night.
records.translation: May isang Slime na nakatakas noong gabi.

records.source: You place the diamond on Grandpa's Shrine.
records.translation: Inilagay mo ang diyamante sa Dambana ni Lolo.

records.source: There's a diamond-shaped slot in the shrine... was that always there?
records.translation: May puwang na hugis-diyamante sa dambana... dati na ba itong naroon?
